description:
Leonardo da Vinci's designs for machines and inventions: flying machines, wings, weapons, mechanisms. Real public-domain works from open-access collections, each with title, date, medium, holding institution, credit, licence, source page and full-resolution link; the first comes back as an image.

Example questions:
- "Show me Leonardo's flying machine"
- "Da Vinci's inventions"
- "Leonardo machine drawings"

limit.description: How many works to list (1-10, default 5).

narrow.description: Optional extra words to narrow the theme (a place, year or motif).

name: leonardo_inventions
title: Inventions and Machines (Leonardo da Vinci)
